insights.name: PROD-556 v2 · 주간 사용자 Funnel (동일 Hashtag · 30분)
insights.description: TagChip 선택→실제로 표시된 관련 Profile 목록→Profile 선택. 동일 Hashtag별 30분 ordered 경로의 사용자 합집합. 반복 탐색은 사용자 분모에 1회. 탐색 session 선택률/Final Error와 수치 연속성 없음. Asia/Seoul 월요일; production Web. PROD-795 제외·live 수집 인수 pending.

source.query:
WITH funnel_events AS (
SELECT person_id AS account_id, properties['hashtag_id'] AS hashtag_id, timestamp, event
  FROM events
  WHERE {filters}
    AND timestamp >= toStartOfWeek(toTimeZone(now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY, 'Asia/Seoul'), 1)
    AND timestamp <= now()
    AND event IN ('profile_hashtag_clicked', 'profile_hashtag_list_viewed', 'profile_hashtag_profile_selected')
    AND properties['$user_id'] != '' AND properties['hashtag_id'] != ''
    AND properties['$host'] = 'kos.moe' AND properties['$lib'] = 'web'
    AND coalesce(properties['$virt_is_bot'], false) = false
    AND coalesce(nullIf(properties['$virt_traffic_type'], ''), 'Regular') = 'Regular'
),
start_weeks AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT account_id, hashtag_id,
    toStartOfWeek(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Asia/Seoul'), 1) AS week
  FROM funnel_events WHERE event = 'profile_hashtag_clicked'
), per_tag_user AS (
  SELECT starts.week, starts.account_id, starts.hashtag_id,
    windowFunnel(1800)(
      toDateTime(observed.timestamp),
      observed.event = 'profile_hashtag_clicked' AND observed.timestamp < starts.week + INTERVAL 7 DAY,
      observed.event = 'profile_hashtag_list_viewed',
      observed.event = 'profile_hashtag_profile_selected'
    ) AS steps
  FROM start_weeks AS starts
  INNER JOIN funnel_events AS observed
    ON observed.account_id = starts.account_id AND observed.hashtag_id = starts.hashtag_id
  WHERE observed.timestamp >= starts.week
    AND observed.timestamp < starts.week + INTERVAL 7 DAY + INTERVAL 30 MINUTE
  GROUP BY starts.week, starts.account_id, starts.hashtag_id
), per_user AS (
  SELECT week, account_id, max(steps) AS steps FROM per_tag_user GROUP BY week, account_id
)
SELECT week, countIf(steps >= 1) AS clicked_users,
  countIf(steps >= 2) AS list_users, countIf(steps >= 3) AS selected_users,
  list_users / nullIf(clicked_users, 0) AS list_reach_rate,
  selected_users / nullIf(clicked_users, 0) AS user_conversion_rate,
  selected_users / nullIf(list_users, 0) AS list_to_selection_rate,
  'prod-556-user-funnel-v2' AS calculation_rule_version, now() AS calculated_at
FROM per_user GROUP BY week ORDER BY week

insights.name: PROD-556 v2 · Hashtag별 사용자 Funnel (30분)
insights.description: 사용자 단위 ordered 30분 Funnel: TagChip→실제 visible nonempty 목록→Profile 선택. hashtag_id event breakdown + all_events로 세 단계의 동일 태그를 요구. 태그별 사용자 수를 더해 전체로 쓰지 않음. Empty·요청 품질은 독립 지표. 기존 session 성과 지표 대체; live 인수 pending.

values.key: properties['$user_id'] != '' AND properties['hashtag_id'] != '' AND coalesce(properties['$virt_is_bot'], false) = false AND coalesce(nullIf(properties['$virt_traffic_type'], ''), 'Regular') = 'Regular'

insights.name: PROD-556 v2 · 최초 Empty 경험 / 전체 화면 진입
insights.description: 화면 진입 단위. 최초 실제 meaningful state가 Empty인 진입 / 전체 진입(loading 이탈·error·notFound 포함). loading/skeleton은 결과 아님. cache/network 출처 무관; 이후 목록·선택도 가능. entered_at으로 진입 주 귀속. 기존 session Empty 비율과 단절. live/제외 인수 pending.

source.query:
WITH observations AS (
  SELECT event, properties['result'] AS result,
    if(event = 'profile_hashtag_initial_state_viewed',
      parseDateTimeBestEffort(properties['entered_at']), timestamp) AS entry_time
  FROM events
  WHERE {filters}
    AND timestamp >= toStartOfWeek(toTimeZone(now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY, 'Asia/Seoul'), 1)
    AND timestamp <= now()
    AND event IN ('profile_hashtag_screen_entered', 'profile_hashtag_initial_state_viewed')
    AND properties['$user_id'] != '' AND properties['$host'] = 'kos.moe' AND properties['$lib'] = 'web'
    AND coalesce(properties['$virt_is_bot'], false) = false
    AND coalesce(nullIf(properties['$virt_traffic_type'], ''), 'Regular') = 'Regular'
)
SELECT toStartOfWeek(toTimeZone(entry_time, 'Asia/Seoul'), 1) AS week,
  countIf(event = 'profile_hashtag_screen_entered') AS screen_entries,
  countIf(event = 'profile_hashtag_initial_state_viewed' AND result = 'empty') AS initial_empty_entries,
  countIf(event = 'profile_hashtag_initial_state_viewed') AS meaningful_entries,
  initial_empty_entries / nullIf(screen_entries, 0) AS initial_empty_rate,
  'prod-556-user-funnel-v2' AS calculation_rule_version, now() AS calculated_at
FROM observations GROUP BY week ORDER BY week

insights.name: PROD-556 v2 · 요청 품질 (success / partial / failure)
insights.description: 실제 요청 완료 단위 initial/pagination 품질. failure/(success+partial+failure), partial 별도. 오류와 사용 가능한 GraphQL 목록은 partial, 사용 가능한 결과 없음은 failure. retry 성공은 앞선 실패를 지우지 않음. cache 목록→background failure는 Funnel 목록과 failure 동시 성립. 종료 기반 Final Error 폐기. live/제외 인수 pending.

source.query:
SELECT toStartOfWeek(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Asia/Seoul'), 1) AS week,
  properties['stage'] AS stage, count() AS completed_requests,
  countIf(properties['result'] = 'success') AS success_requests,
  countIf(properties['result'] = 'partial') AS partial_requests,
  countIf(properties['result'] = 'failure') AS failure_requests,
  failure_requests / nullIf(completed_requests, 0) AS complete_failure_rate,
  partial_requests / nullIf(completed_requests, 0) AS partial_response_rate,
  'prod-556-user-funnel-v2' AS calculation_rule_version, now() AS calculated_at
FROM events
WHERE {filters}
    AND timestamp >= toStartOfWeek(toTimeZone(now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY, 'Asia/Seoul'), 1)
  AND timestamp <= now()
  AND event = 'profile_hashtag_request_completed'
  AND properties['result'] IN ('success', 'partial', 'failure')
  AND properties['$user_id'] != '' AND properties['$host'] = 'kos.moe' AND properties['$lib'] = 'web'
  AND coalesce(properties['$virt_is_bot'], false) = false
  AND coalesce(nullIf(properties['$virt_traffic_type'], ''), 'Regular') = 'Regular'
GROUP BY week, stage ORDER BY week, stage
